summary: Verified compact FabBar CSS changes for customer & driver. Bottom-sheet bottom is now 56px and fab-bar bottom is 8px → sheet bottom edge ends at y=788 and fab-bar top is at y=796, giving a clean 8px gap with NO map strip between them. Primary fab buttons render as horizontal pills (width>height) at 32px content height (40px including bar padding), well under the 50px limit. Modal opens/closes correctly on custom button click. All 7 acceptance criteria from the review request pass.

issues: Pre-existing: 'Location watch error: GeolocationPositionError' logs on every /driver mount (geolocation denied in test env). Not a regression.

critical_code_review_comments: index.css .bottom-sheet.with-fabbar.collapsed rule (line ~124 in earlier iterations) is still identical to .bottom-sheet.collapsed (transform-based). If still present, it can be removed as redundant.

FabBar custom buttons render fine but truncated labels (max-width:90px) plus 12px font + 18px icons + gap is tight in narrow viewports — currently fits 390px with 2 customer buttons (302px total). If a 3rd custom button is added, total width may approach the max-width:calc(100% - 32px) cap and labels may ellipsize. Acceptable for now.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused existing customer FAB buttons 'Помощь' and 'Рейтинг'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Compact FabBar verified at mobile 390x844 viewport. Measured values: FAB bar height=40px (8px padding + 32px button), primary button width=102px (customer 'Вызвать') / 106px (driver 'На линии'). Sheet has class 'bottom-sheet slide-up with-fabbar'. Sheet bottom edge y=788, FAB top y=796 → gap=8px. Customer total FAB width=302px (3 buttons), Driver=114px (1 button). All buttons are horizontal pills (icon + label inline, width > height). Modal flow: click custom fab btn → fab-modal overlay appears → fab-modal-close button dismisses. Test selectors: [data-testid=fab-bar], [data-testid=fab-btn-primary], [data-testid^=fab-btn-], [data-testid=fab-modal], [data-testid=fab-modal-close]. Login flow: /login → click role tile ('Войти как заказчик'/'Войти как исполнитель') → fill phone in single input → tick 2 consent checkboxes (customer only) → 'Продолжить' → single OTP input (not 4 boxes) fill '1234' → 'Подтвердить' → 'Пропустить' on PIN setup → land on /customer or /driver.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration validates a CSS-only compactness fix. Previous iteration had bottom:16px on fab-bar and 76px on .with-fabbar sheet (90px lift), leaving a visible map strip between. Current values (fab-bar bottom:8px, sheet bottom:56px, fab-btn min-height:32px with padding 6px 10px and horizontal flex row layout) produce an 8px gap that visually closes the strip while keeping the FAB tappable. Verified live on both customer (3 buttons) and driver (1 button) routes.
